traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Sphaerosepalaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; veins pinnate or palmate; leaves deciduous; stipules present; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior or half inferior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers actinomorphic or zygomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; stamens 25 to 100; carpels (2-) 3 (-5). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
